title: rest: the dataset query door answers 503 at an App pair two modules share beside a package-less row under plugin-wired admission, where ADR-0150 D4 calls for 409 naming both (follow-up of #32292)
body:
domain:server#7 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVSjQBHNkZd6Eqx2XX

Follow-up of #32292 (PR #32804). Source: the epic red-line delta read on PR #32808's landing head (6839753325). Queued, not dispatched (dispatch is p0/p1 only, ruling 6837849715 on #31527).

## What happens

Under an analytics service with plugin-wired admission, two modules of an App hold a dataset NAME and a package-less row of NAME sits beside them. `POST /analytics/dataset/query?package=APP.custom` answers `503` (the admission arm's fail-closed outcome: one holder's admission cannot be judged) where ADR-0150 D4 says a package-less row beside two real holders is no one's customization and the name refuses `409` naming both.

## Owed

Find why the admission arm cannot judge one holder in this composition, make the door answer per D4 (409 naming the admitted holders, as the #32292 narrowing does), FROM → TO, pins red on `main` and green after; both registration orders, single door and `/batch`.
